newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December T-bonds finish lower before weekend.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December T-bonds finish lower before weekend.

text.p: Nov 15 - U.S. Dec T-bonds returned near session lows in afternoon trading and finished lower amid pre-weekend profit-taking. Traders and technicians said the market was bumping against significant resistance near nine-month highs. Still, Dec closed above the 114-25/32 session low. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
